findingsForOTHERSEATSFiledNotFixed.id: walk classifier passes an unrecognised absence verdict as a VALUE
findingsForOTHERSEATSFiledNotFixed.detail: An object whose verdict is not one of absent-verified / not-applicable / refused falls through to {state:'value', ok:true}. So a served 'stamp-missing' or 'unmeasured' zoning verdict, and a parcel_record ZoningFactAbsent (which carries state:'absent' with the real verdict nested at absence.kind), all grade as POPULATED. Measured on the Caldwell cohort: 25 of 25 rails graded 'value' while 3 of them are actually not-applicable.
findingsForOTHERSEATSFiledNotFixed.consequence: BP-CONTENT-01 currently cannot tell a zoning district from an honest zoning absence. It is pre-existing, this lane does not widen it, and this lane deliberately does not exploit it -- that is exactly why lookup-failed is mapped to refused instead of being passed through raw.
